# incident_access_privileges (Data Source)

List the privileges that access can grant.

Use this to check a privilege name before you grant it, and to find out when a name is
deprecated or is an alias of another privilege.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the privileges an access grant can give.
data "incident_access_privileges" "all" {}

output "privilege_names" {
  value = [for privilege in data.incident_access_privileges.all.privileges : privilege.name]
}

# Deprecated privileges still work, but are left out unless you ask for them.
data "incident_access_privileges" "including_deprecated" {
  include_deprecated = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_deprecated` (Boolean) Whether to include deprecated privileges. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `privileges` (Attributes List) The privileges an access grant can give. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--privileges))

<a id="nestedatt--privileges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `privileges`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (List of String) Earlier names of this privilege. Granting an alias grants this privilege.
- `children` (List of String) Names of the privileges this privilege grants as well as its own
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether new grants should use another privilege instead. A deprecated privilege still works.
- `description` (String) What the privilege allows, where the label needs more context
- `grants_nothing` (Boolean) Whether the privilege is retired: it grants no permissions and has no children. A grant that holds it gives no access.
- `label` (String) Human readable label of the privilege
- `name` (String) Unique name of the privilege. Use this name to grant it.
- `parents` (List of String) Names of the privileges whose children include this privilege
- `replaced_by` (List of String) Names of the privileges to use instead of a deprecated one
